subject.title: [Feature Request] ACP Session Skill Context Injection

question: What ACP skill-injection contract should OpenClaw support for `sessions_spawn(runtime: "acp")`, if any?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but implementation needs product/security intent for selection mode, default config, redaction, audit metadata, and interaction with native child-harness skill systems.

options.title: Design explicit opt-in contract
options.body: Add explicit skill selection first, with redaction and audit metadata, and defer auto/default injection until the behavior is proven safe.

options.title: Fold into broader harness parity
options.body: Treat ACP injection as part of the wider skill prompt-contract parity work before adding any ACP-specific surface.

options.title: Decline core injection
options.body: Keep ACP harnesses isolated and require users to pass any desired skill instructions manually or through harness-native mechanisms.

recommendation.title: Design explicit opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Add explicit skill selection first, with redaction and audit metadata, and defer auto/default injection until the behavior is proven safe.

likelyOwner.reason: The ACP thread-bound spawn and related `sessions_spawn` history makes this the best available routing owner for the contract decision.
